_about: Every public-domain John Newton (1725-1807) prose text the Word Hoard holds. His hymns are not shelved here: the Olney Hymns go to the hymn manifest. The target is the six-volume Works (1810), Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted, each volume number read off its title page, plus Josiah Bull's 1869 collection of letters not in the Works. CCEL's two volumes of Messiah (fifty discourses on the texts of Handel's oratorio) are held clean. No Gutenberg Newton prose found this burn. Not Isaac Newton or the other John Newtons.
